title: 我养你啊 v3 · 周星驰致敬

MAN.label: a young Chinese man in his late 20s, short black hair, thin build, plain white tank top vest, ordinary underdog small-figure vibe, in the style of 90s Hong Kong cinema
MAN.picture_retention: fully_preserved - the white tank top, short hair, thin face
MAN.note: the man (main character, identical in all shots)

WOMAN.label: a young Chinese woman in her early 20s, shoulder-length black hair, innocent pure face, plain simple casual top, 90s Hong Kong girl look
WOMAN.picture_retention: fully_preserved - shoulder-length hair, pure face, simple top
WOMAN.note: the woman (main character, identical in all shots)

STREET.label: the Hong Kong old narrow night street: old residential buildings, clothes-drying poles, dim yellow street lamps, wet reflective asphalt, a worn old red taxi parked at the roadside
STREET.picture_retention: fully_preserved - old buildings, dim lamps, wet road, red taxi

shots.name: shot01
shots.action: [Shot 1] A slow lateral pan across the empty Hong Kong old narrow night street. A worn old red taxi is parked at the roadside under a dim yellow street lamp. Old residential buildings with clothes-drying poles line both sides. The wet asphalt reflects the lamp light. No people. Quiet, waiting atmosphere.
shots.sound: quiet night street ambience: distant traffic, faint taxi engine idle, night breeze
shots.music: a soft slow piano melody, sparse and wistful, 90s Hong Kong romance film style

zh.action: 镜头缓慢横移，扫过空无一人的香港老式窄巷夜街。一辆破旧红色出租车停在路边昏黄路灯下。两侧老居民楼晾衣杆林立。湿漉漉的沥青路面反射着灯光。空无一人，安静而等待的氛围。
zh.sound: 安静的夜街环境音：远处的车流声、出租车怠速低鸣、夜风
zh.music: 舒缓缓慢的钢琴旋律，稀疏而怅然，90 年代港式爱情片风格

shots.name: shot02
shots.action: [Shot 1] A medium shot of [Subject 1], the young man in the white tank top, standing at the street corner of [Subject 2] at night. He watches in the direction of the red taxi, hesitant and reluctant, hands hanging at his sides. Dim warm streetlight falls on his face. Melancholic mood. He does not speak.
shots.sound: night street ambience: distant traffic, faint breeze
shots.music: a soft slow piano melody, gentle and wistful

zh.action: 中景：穿白色背心的青年站在街角（夜间），望着红色出租车方向，犹豫不舍，双手垂在身侧。昏黄的暖色路灯落在他脸上。忧郁氛围，他没有说话。
zh.sound: 夜街环境音：远处车流声，微风
zh.music: 轻柔缓慢的钢琴旋律，温和而怅然

shots.name: shot03
shots.action: [Shot 1] [Subject 1], the young woman, sits in the back seat of the old red taxi at the roadside of [Subject 2]. She turns her head slightly toward the window, quiet and sad. The taxi headlights are on. Night street visible through the window. She does not speak.
shots.sound: car engine starting, low hum, night street ambience
shots.music: a soft slow piano melody, melancholy

zh.action: 年轻女子坐在路边红色出租车的后座，微微转头望向车窗，安静而悲伤。车头灯亮着，窗外可见夜街。她没有说话。
zh.sound: 汽车发动声，低沉的引擎嗡鸣，夜街环境音
zh.music: 轻柔缓慢的钢琴旋律，忧郁

shots.name: shot04
shots.action: [Shot 1] A lateral tracking shot: [Subject 1], the young man in the white tank top, runs along [Subject 2], chasing after the red taxi which is driving away. His expression is anxious and desperate. He stumbles slightly but keeps running. Night street lamps blur past. He does not speak yet.
shots.sound: footsteps running on pavement, distant traffic, breath

zh.action: 侧向跟拍：穿白色背心的青年沿街奔跑，追着驶离的红色出租车。神情焦急而绝望，脚下踉跄了一下但继续跑。夜街路灯从身边掠过。他还没说话。
zh.sound: 人行道上奔跑的脚步声，远处车流，喘息声

shots.name: shot05
shots.speaker: S1
shots.action: [Shot 1] A close-up of [Subject 1], the young man in the white tank top, standing on the night street of [Subject 2], facing the direction of the departing taxi. He takes a breath and shouts loudly with a determined, tearful expression.
shots.sound: his shouting voice (S1), distant traffic, night breeze

zh.action: 特写：穿白色背心的青年站在夜街上，面朝出租车离去的方向，深吸一口气，带着坚定而含泪的表情大声喊出。
zh.sound: 他的喊声（男主角），远处车流，夜风
zh.music: 缓慢钢琴，情绪涌动而心酸

shots.name: shot06
shots.action: [Shot 1] Inside the taxi: [Subject 1], the young woman, turns her head back toward the rear window, eyes brimming with tears, lips slightly pressed. The night street of [Subject 2] blurs behind the glass. She does not speak. Deeply touched, silent.
shots.sound: faint car engine, quiet night ambience
shots.music: soft slow piano, tender and moving

zh.action: 出租车内：年轻女子回头望向车窗，眼眶含泪，双唇微抿。窗外的夜街在玻璃上模糊成光斑。她没有说话，深受触动，沉默无言。
zh.sound: 微弱的汽车引擎声，安静的夜晚环境音
zh.music: 轻柔缓慢的钢琴，温柔而动人
